name: the listing pages are not matched
why: bb-year-list's match: without it a listing is bb-page (previews only, no button).

name: the listings ignore the year pages' switch
why: sa_bb_year_pages gates the listing pages too: off, nothing visible happens.

name: the note is not read
why: An entry's (Recording Session), (Rehearsal), … goes to the Note column.

name: the note keeps its parentheses
why: The site writes (Recording Session); the column holds the words.

name: a tour box is ignored
why: A box between the lists names (start) or clears (end) the tour of the entries after it.

name: ", and Start of" does not split
why: 1981's "End of the 1st leg, and Start of the 2nd leg of … - Europe" starts the 2nd leg; read as one part it is an End.

name: the Event link is not marked a show link
why: a.mb-bb-show-link, not the year table's mb-bb-event-link (whose links are the event pages').

name: a fetched listing is not converted
why: "All years" fetches the other listings: each is converted in the fetch loop.

name: the live listing is emptied for all years (the first version)
why: The engine reuses the live document for this year's key: an empty table there loses this year's rows.

const content = docContext.getElementById('page-content');

name: Load from Disk does not convert the reloaded listing
why: The third call site (the disk load reloads the live page). No spec loads a listing from disk yet; a Save → Load from Disk test like bb-year.spec.js's would see it.
